street.methodSummary: After Q1FY27 the street values UPL on one consolidated multiple (P/E: Motilal Oswal 12x, Jefferies 14x Jun-28E; EV/EBITDA: Elara 6.3x, Arihant 7.5x FY28E). Of the brokers whose method we found, four use P/E (adding Anand Rathi 15x and Antique 16x FY28E), two EV/EBITDA and one (Nuvama) a platform SOTP with a 20% holdco discount. P/E is the dominant method.
